timeout_seconds.description: Initial exact-head CI observation window in seconds; retained windows do not restart on resume.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Delay between CI observations in seconds.

no_checks_grace_seconds.description: Wait for absent checks before reporting no_checks, which does not satisfy CI.

pending_extension_seconds.description: One additional window allowed only while checks are pending.

max_pending_extensions.description: Zero disables the pending extension; one retains the existing one-extension ceiling.
